title: Application Accepted
blurb: Marcus falls in the duck pond for the fourth time, and this time the pond accepts his application. Doug picks up the helmet and goes in after him. Nine floors, and the only way out is down.
note: Captions stay on. This film teaches nothing on purpose: it ends by handing the class the four-question opening check, which students do alone and in silence. Up top Doug only says "Coo"; under the pond Marcus can understand him.
